title: Analytic: Mie resonance and Q of a silicon sphere in D2O (3D FDFD eigenfrequency, eighth model)
description:
A silicon sphere (n = 3.47, r = 200 nm) in D2O (n = 1.32) solved by the eigenfrequency study of em_fdfd_3d near its magnetic-dipole (TE_1) resonance. Eighth model: the sphere centre sits on the domain corner, x_lo / y_lo are antisymmetric mirrors and z_lo a symmetric mirror (the parity sector of the m_z magnetic dipole, whose E circles the z axis), CPML (8 cells) on the hi faces after 300 nm of D2O, 25 nm cells (8 per radius), solver_defaults.subpixel_smoothing on; ~73k unknowns. GPU only: the eigen solver node uses factorization cudss_mixed (needs nvmath-python; a complex64 cuDSS LDL^T with float64 refinement, then Rayleigh quotients), seconds where the host SuperLU factor (Automatic, cpu backend) takes minutes and a few GB.
Analytic (Mie, exp(-i omega t) as in Bohren-Huffman, m = n_si / n_d2o, x = n_d2o k0 r): the TE_1 pole is the complex root of psi_1(m x) xi_1'(x) = m xi_1(x) psi_1'(m x), psi_1(z) = sin z / z - cos z, xi_1(x) = -e^{i x} (1 + i / x); here x = 1.11614 - 0.09098 i (by complex Newton on the closed-form l = 1 functions; selftests_fdfd3d._mie_poles finds it with scipy), so lambda_mie = 2 pi n_d2o r / Re x = 1.4862 um and Q_mie = Re x / (2 |Im x|) = 6.134. open_sol uses exp(+j omega t): the same pole has Im omega > 0 (decaying), the same Q.
Derived values tab: lambda_1 and Q_1 (row 0 of em.resonances = the resonance nearest the target, which is lambda_mie) vs the Mie values; pml_1 = the resonance's share of the electric energy in the CPML (a leaky mode with Q ~6 carries a visible share; above 0.5 it would be filtered).
Field tab: the Snapshot slider shows each resonance (e_abs, cut planes through the sphere centre; the image cells fill the other seven octants).
Expected agreement (measured on this grid): lambda_1 1.0e-2 blue of the pole, Q_1 4e-3. The wavelength error is the subpixel average's own bias, first order in the cell: it is diagonal (no eps_xy terms) with in-plane normals per z layer, so the tangential E of the m_z dipole on the oblique sphere faces sees eps biased low (the staircase sits 2.8e-3 red; thinner / nearer CPML changed lambda by < 2e-4; Yee dispersion, up to (k d)^2 / 24 ~ 5e-3 in silicon, pulls the other way, red). Tolerance lambda_1 2e-2 (twice the measured bias, which halves only at twice the cells, ~8x the unknowns), Q_1 15 %; switch subpixel_smoothing off to see the staircase shift.
